workbook_reference.label: Workbook reference
workbook_reference.purpose: Unchanged workbook inputs, premium-only reconciliation. Physical-state conflicts are reported, not resolved.

physical_state_conflicts.DEMO-P005: post_fbc_2002 includes roof_straps by construction but the workbook records none installed. Premium-only preset; use the app_consistent_demo preset for any physical loss comparison.
physical_state_conflicts.DEMO-P008: post_fbc_2002 includes roof_straps by construction but the workbook records none installed. Premium-only preset; use the app_consistent_demo preset for any physical loss comparison.

app_consistent_demo.label: App-consistent demo
app_consistent_demo.purpose: Default insurer simulation. Post-2002 homes have their class-inherent roof straps installed and credited at baseline, in both arms; this is a demo assumption, not property evidence.

normalized_policies.DEMO-P005: Class-inherent straps assumed installed and credited at baseline.
normalized_policies.DEMO-P008: Class-inherent straps assumed installed and credited at baseline.

program_note: Grant share, cap, inspection, setup, admin, budget, horizon and discount rate are new demo assumptions from the specification, not workbook inputs.

reference_totals.note: The workbook's own totals (Portfolio Summary) and the specification's normalized totals. The importer refuses to write these fixtures unless the premium engine reproduces both to the cent; see backend/tests/test_premium.py.

loss_results_note: Computed on request by app/mitigation_states.py (one current/resulting pair per policy and event, on the curve set's physical states) rather than stored here; the insurer endpoints that call it come next.
